gpu-canvas.title: End-to-end GPU tiled canvas and compositing
gpu-canvas.description: Build a GPU tiled canvas, rendering, and compositing pipeline with wgpu.

layer-blending.title: Layer blend modes
layer-blending.description: Support common layer blend modes in the GPU compositing pipeline.

layer-stack.title: Basic layer stack
layer-stack.description: Support pixel layers, layer groups, and basic layer stack operations.

canvas-mipmaps.title: Canvas mipmaps and linear filtering
canvas-mipmaps.description: Use mipmaps and linear filtering to keep the canvas smooth at different zoom levels.

icc-color.title: GPU-accelerated ICC color management
icc-color.description: Compile ICC profiles directly into GPU shaders for precise real-time color conversion.

color-picker.title: Customizable multi-model color picker
color-picker.description: Support RGB, HSL, HSV, CIE Lab, and OkLab, with a customizable panel layout.

shader-graph.title: Shader Graph editor
shader-graph.description: Provide a visual WESL/WGSL editor with curves, random values, loops, custom expressions, and function subgraphs.

brush-engine.title: Programmable node-based brush engine
brush-engine.description: Use Shader Graph to power brushes with real-time stroke previews.

abr-parser.title: Clean-room .abr parser
abr-parser.description: Provide an independent parser for Adobe Photoshop .abr brush files.

photoshop-brushes.title: Photoshop brush engine compatibility
photoshop-brushes.description: Support Photoshop brush parameters and behavior in the node-based rendering pipeline.

node-filters.title: Programmable node-based filters
node-filters.description: Use Shader Graph to run programmable image filters on the GPU.

layer-effects.title: Programmable node-based layer effects
layer-effects.description: Use Shader Graph to apply programmable layer effects.

input-stabilizer.title: Basic stroke smoothing and stabilization
input-stabilizer.description: Smooth input strokes and reduce jitter.

brush-tool.title: Basic brush tool
brush-tool.description: Provide core painting tools with pressure sensitivity and node-based brushes.

fill-tool.title: Basic fill tool
fill-tool.description: Fill regions and close gaps at their boundaries.

eyedropper.title: Basic eyedropper
eyedropper.description: Sample colors from the canvas in real time.

selection-tools.title: Selection tools
selection-tools.description: Provide rectangular, elliptical, freehand lasso, polygonal lasso, and magic wand selection tools.

transform-tools.title: Transform tools
transform-tools.description: Provide free, perspective, and liquify transforms.

canvas-controls.title: Canvas controls
canvas-controls.description: Pan, rotate, zoom, and mirror the canvas.

lazuli-format.title: Crash-resistant .lazuli tiled project format
lazuli-format.description: Use a native SQLite-based tiled project format to reduce the risk of document corruption after a crash.

lazuli-save.title: Incremental .lazuli saving
lazuli-save.description: Write only changed tiles and data to save faster. Initial desktop support is available, and support across all platforms is in progress.

raster-io.title: Common raster image import and export
raster-io.description: Import and export common raster formats such as PNG, JPG, and AVIF.

dock-workspace.title: Dockable tabbed workspace
dock-workspace.description: Dock and group panels freely, and switch between tabs.

shortcuts.title: Custom keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Configure shortcuts for global actions and tools.

asset-packs.title: Asset packs
asset-packs.description: Manage built-in and external packs of brushes, filters, effects, and textures in one place.

undo-redo.title: Undo and redo
undo-redo.description: Support multiple undo and redo steps for canvas and document operations.

fluent.title: Fluent localization
fluent.description: Use Fluent to support multiple languages.

cross-platform.title: Cross-platform build support
cross-platform.description: Use one codebase for Windows, Linux, macOS, and Android.

layer-lock.title: Layer locking
layer-lock.description: Enforce layer locks across layer stack operations and editing tools.

channel-lock.title: Channel locking
channel-lock.description: Enforce color and alpha channel locks across pixel editing tools.

psd-io.title: PSD project import and export
psd-io.description: Import and export Adobe Photoshop .psd project files.

near-term.title: Near-term plans
near-term.description: Make painting smoother, more complete, and easier to use

clipping-masks.title: Photoshop-style clipping masks
clipping-masks.description: Use clipping layers to restrict upper-layer content to the visible area of the lower layer.

alpha-inheritance.title: Krita-style alpha inheritance
alpha-inheritance.description: Let layers in a group inherit alpha from the layers beneath them.

transparency-masks.title: Non-destructive transparency masks
transparency-masks.description: Control layer visibility with a separate transparency mask child layer.

filter-layers.title: Non-destructive filter layers and masks
filter-layers.description: Use adjustable filter layers and local filter masks that can be toggled at any time.

lazuli-compatibility.title: Custom .lazuli data and compatibility
lazuli-compatibility.description: Serialize custom layer data and handle forward and backward document format compatibility.

compositing-cache.title: Incremental compositing cache
compositing-cache.description: Build and reuse blend results as needed to reduce redraw work.

brush-preview-cache.title: On-disk brush preview cache
brush-preview-cache.description: Cache brush stroke previews by asset ID to load panels faster.

canvas-navigator.title: Canvas Navigator dock
canvas-navigator.description: Show a canvas thumbnail and provide quick panning and zooming.

history-dock.title: History dock
history-dock.description: Show the undo stack and jump directly to a history state.

palette-dock.title: Palette dock
palette-dock.description: Manage swatches, save color schemes, and pick colors quickly.

brush-history.title: Brush History dock
brush-history.description: Keep recently used brush presets available for quick switching.

quick-actions.title: Quick Actions panel
quick-actions.description: Customize a panel of actions and key combinations for faster or keyboard-free work.

mid-term.title: Mid-term plans
mid-term.description: Build professional illustration tools and flexible programmable workflows

node-layer-system.title: Fully node-based layer system
node-layer-system.description: Use a dedicated Shader Graph editor to customize layer blending and execution order beyond the traditional layer stack.

brush-performance.title: Brush engine performance improvements
brush-performance.description: Improve brush rendering, scheduling, and large strokes to reduce latency on high-resolution canvases.

vector-layers.title: Vector layers
vector-layers.description: Support resolution-independent paths, geometric shapes, and non-destructive vector editing.

text-layout.title: Text shapes and layout
text-layout.description: Edit text as vector shapes inside vector layers rather than as separate layers.

drawing-guides.title: Drawing guides
drawing-guides.description: Provide symmetry rulers and one-, two-, and three-point perspective guides.

reference-images.title: Canvas reference images
reference-images.description: Place and scale reference images freely on the canvas and sample colors directly from them, as in Krita.

fp16.title: End-to-end 16-bit floating-point color
fp16.description: Use FP16 across the pipeline for high dynamic range pixel storage, blending, and filter calculations.

hdr-output.title: HDR display output
hdr-output.description: Show high dynamic range canvas content accurately on HDR displays.

soft-proofing.title: Soft proofing
soft-proofing.description: Preview target color spaces. CMYK is available for soft proofing only, not direct editing.

histogram.title: Histogram dock
histogram.description: Show real-time color and lightness distributions to help judge color and exposure.

time-lapse.title: Time-lapse dock and video export
time-lapse.description: Record painting with low overhead, then preview and export the time-lapse in a built-in panel.

kra-io.title: KRA project import and export
kra-io.description: Import and export Krita .kra project files.

clip-studio-brushes.title: Clip Studio Paint brush compatibility
clip-studio-brushes.description: Parse and import Clip Studio Paint .sut brushes.

long-term.title: Long-term vision
long-term.description: Explore 2D and 3D workflows, procedural materials, and an open ecosystem

pixel-art.title: Pixel art tools
pixel-art.description: Provide dedicated brushes and canvas tools for pixel art, including Pixel Perfect strokes.

blender-materials.title: Blender material painting integration
blender-materials.description: Paint Blender materials directly in Lapiz and sync them with Blender.

blender-viewport.title: Blender 3D viewport reference
blender-viewport.description: Project the live Blender 3D viewport onto the canvas as a painting reference.

procedural-nodes.title: Built-in filter assets and procedural nodes
procedural-nodes.description: Provide built-in filter presets and nodes for procedural texture generation.

pbr-output.title: Seamless tiling and multichannel PBR output
pbr-output.description: Support seamless tiling in both directions and export multichannel PBR textures for selected procedural material workflows.

rust-plugins.title: Native Rust plugin API
rust-plugins.description: Provide a stable interface for writing high-performance plugins directly in Rust.

mobile.title: Mobile and tablet support
mobile.description: Improve touch gestures and provide a lightweight workspace for tablets and touchscreens.

frame-animation.title: Frame-by-frame animation and Timeline dock
frame-animation.description: Provide a timeline and onion skinning for basic frame-by-frame animation.
